explanation: F_k(n) (maxLinesAtLeast) and f_k(n) (maxLinesExactly) are the maximum numbers of determined lines with ≥ k, respectively exactly k, of n points in ℝ², matching erdosproblems.com/669; the counts are bounded, so the sSup is attained. BGS proved F₃(n) = n²/6 − O(n). The statement F₃(n) − n²/6 = O(n) matches, since F₃ ≤ C(n,2)/3 trivially. Faithful.
